title: AntiFox AI Pentesting Platform Linked to Attacks That Accessed AWS Production Secrets
content_md: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a campaign in which an emerging agentic penetration testing platform called AntiFox has been used to steal Amazon Web Services (AWS) credentials and pivot laterally into compromised environments.
